delete.account.body: This permanently deletes your account and everything in it: habits, check-ins, journal entries and achievements. legal.draft: Draft. This text has not been reviewed by a lawyer yet and may change before launch.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.what.heading: What we keep
legal.privacy.what.body: Your email address and sign-in details (held by our sign-in provider), the theme you chose, your timezone and reminder time, your habits and check-ins, your journal entries and moods, and your achievements. We also keep a record of your one-time purchase.
legal.privacy.journal.heading: Your journal is yours
legal.privacy.journal.body: Journal text is stored only so you can read, search and export it. Our team can't read it through any admin tool, it never appears in logs or analytics, and it is never used on share cards or for advertising. We don't sell your data.
legal.privacy.who.heading: Who handles it
legal.privacy.who.body: We use Cloudflare to run the app, Supabase (hosted in the United States) to store data, Clerk for sign-in, Stripe for payments and Resend to send reminder emails. Each only receives what it needs to do its job.
legal.privacy.transfer.heading: Transfers outside your country
legal.privacy.transfer.body: Your data is stored in the United States. If you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, that is a transfer of your data outside your region, which relies on our storage provider's data processing agreement and the Standard Contractual Clauses (or the EU-US Data Privacy Framework).
legal.privacy.rights.heading: Your choices
legal.privacy.rights.body: You can download everything you have stored, or delete your account and all its data, at any time from Settings. Deletion is immediate in the live service, and copies in backups are removed as those backups rotate out, within 30 days. Reminder emails have a one-click unsubscribe.
legal.privacy.cookies.heading: Cookies
legal.privacy.cookies.body: We use only the cookies needed to keep you signed in. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
legal.terms.title: Terms of use
legal.terms.what.heading: What you're buying
legal.terms.what.body: littleHYPE is a one-time purchase that gives one person lifetime access to the app and the theme they choose at sign-up. It is not a subscription. The theme is locked to your account.
legal.terms.refund.heading: Refunds
legal.terms.refund.body: You can ask for a refund within 14 days of purchase. A refund removes your access and permanently deletes all of your data, and you will be warned before it is processed.
legal.terms.use.heading: Using the app
legal.terms.use.body: The app is for your own personal use. Please keep your sign-in private, and don't try to break or misuse the service.
legal.terms.content.heading: Your content
legal.terms.content.body: What you write is yours. We only store and show it to you. Sharing a card is always your choice, and cards never contain journal text.
legal.terms.changes.heading: Changes
legal.terms.changes.body: We may update these terms or the app. If we make a change that matters, we will tell you before it applies.
